cannibalization_controls: One primary search intent per language per canonical landing.
English targets are independently selected and must not be literal translations by default.
When two sessions share a verse/theme, assign different problem/question intents and adjacent long-tail territory.
Do not publish numeric monthly search volume without a verifiable keyword-volume source.
Re-check existing ID and EN registry before every new session.

001-004.method: live SERP inspection; head-term saturation and intent adjacency checked; no numeric volume claimed without first-party volume source
notes: 001 moved from generic exact-phrase meaning toward practical-life intent because exact phrase SERP is crowded by major media.
002 retains Al-Baqarah 1-5 characteristics intent; adjacent target captures everyday-life application.
003 uses direct question intent in both languages; English SERP shows strong established demand and high competition.
004 separated from session 023: 004 owns leadership/decision justice; 023 remains returning trusts to rightful owners.

005-008.method: live bilingual SERP inspection plus cannibalization QC against adjacent sessions; no numeric volume claimed
notes: 005 ID narrowed to explicit Al-Hujurat 49:11 behavior intent (mockery/offensive names), leaving suspicion-spying-backbiting to 015.
006 owns hardship coping through patience and prayer (2:45); 018 owns 'with hardship comes ease' meaning and 032 owns burden/capacity meaning.
007 owns action intent: how to return to Allah after sin; 031 owns emotional/despair intent for someone who feels their sins are too many.
008 owns misconception intent: tawakkul is not inaction; distinct from hardship and repentance clusters.
EN targets are independent search formulations, not literal ID translations.

notes: 009 owns practical gratitude-through-action intent, not generic gratitude definition.
